name: Concordia University
summary: English-language university in Montreal, formed in 1974: about 35,600 undergraduates in four faculties on a downtown and a west-end campus.

ib.text: IB Diploma holders are admitted to the 120-credit Extended Credit Program, with transfer credit for HL courses graded 4+. Maths is required for BComm, BCompSc, BSc and BEng; business wants a predicted 29.

dates.label: Apply by: U.S. and international applicants, fall entry (immigration processing)
Film Production: application and portfolio deadline, fall 2027

programmes.name: Commerce (John Molson School of Business)
programmes.about: A business degree at the AACSB-accredited John Molson School with options from accountancy and finance to business analytics and supply chain, co-op options, and international exchanges, in downtown Montreal.
programmes.ib: A predicted 29 points and a predicted 5 in SL or 4 in HL Maths (AA or AI, either level). An English proficiency test may also be needed.

needs.note: A predicted 5 at SL or 4 at HL

programmes.selectionNote: Predicted IB total of 29 or more and the Maths grade; the offer comes with the 120-credit Extended Credit Program.

flagshipSource.title: John Molson bachelor program: AACSB accredited, co-op options, international exchanges and ten BComm options

programmes.name: Film Production
programmes.about: A competitive program in which you work on the making of a film every year, with hands-on technical training and film history and theory, studios from analog to digital, and Montreal's film industry on the doorstep.
programmes.ib: A portfolio of moving-image work and a letter of intent are required, submitted through SlideRoom after the online application. There is no winter entry.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive: the portfolio and letter of intent are judged by the Mel Hoppenheim School of Cinema, in addition to Concordia's minimum admission requirements.

flagshipSource.title: Film Production (BFA): you work on the making of a film every year, in a competitive program

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Science
faculties.line: BA has no subject prerequisites; BSc needs Maths and one science with one at HL; BA mathematics programs need Maths.

faculties.name: John Molson School of Business
faculties.line: Predicted 29 points and Maths at 5 (SL) or 4 (HL); an English proficiency test may be required.

faculties.name: Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science
faculties.line: BEng needs Maths and Physics, one at HL; BCompSc needs Maths; Health and Life Sciences stream adds a science.

faculties.name: Faculty of Fine Arts
faculties.line: BFA programs add a portfolio, audition or letter of intent set by the department; Film Production closes on 1 March.

notes: Concordia teaches in English and sets no French admission requirement; Montreal life and Quebec immigration paperwork are partly in French.
IB English A or Literature and Performance at SL or HL satisfies the English proficiency requirement.
Concordia's application page prints its deadlines without a year; the 1 February date for international applicants is for fall entry.
